descriptionChirho: A person belonging to the tribe of Benjamin, used as a gentilic designation with various orthographic and morphological forms (ben-yemini, ben-yamin). All occurrences refer to the same tribal identity. Spanish uses 'benjaminita/benjamita' (Benjaminite) and 'hijo de Benjamín' (son of Benjamin), Arabic uses 'binyāmīnī' (بنيامينيّ, Benjaminite) and 'yamīnī' (يمينيّ, Yeminite), Korean uses 'Benyamin saram' (베냐민 사람, Benjamin person) consistently, Hindi uses 'Binyāmīnī' (बिन्यामीनी, Benjaminite) uniformly, and Swahili uses 'Mbenyamini' (Benjaminite) throughout. The variant S87311 'Yemini' and S87316 contextual 'a man' are both part of the same gentilic identification pattern.
